figures_added.what: Two cafe-table layouts (1 table = 4 seats, 2 tables = 6 seats) making the growing-by-2 sequence concrete before the algebra. Numbers match the opener boxes (6 and 8 seats) and the derived rule 2n+2.
Three matchstick square patterns in a row labelled 4, 7, 10 (the classic GCSE pattern-sequence figure). Counts match the bronze teach walk: d=3, zero term 1, rule 3n+1.

notes: Sequences bank is entirely numeric (sequences given as numbers), so per the exam-realism test no bank problem prints a figure and none was added. Figures were added where the exam WOULD print one: the opener (growing tables) and the bronze teach walk (matchstick pattern). All SVGs are self-contained, theme-safe (currentColor strokes/text, soft fills at 0.3 opacity), no external refs, Inter labels, under the size budget. Every visible number is checked against the problem/walk numbers.
